title: PULSEFADE
subtitle: Catch a rhythm that refuses to stay still
shortDescription: A minimalist one-tap rhythm arcade built around acceleration, pauses and deceptive timing.
fullDescription: PULSEFADE is a rhythm arcade where each incoming ring visualizes the duration of the next interval.
Tap as the pulse meets the target, build perfect streaks and adapt to readable tempo patterns.
Play Adaptive, Chaos, Marathon, Zen and local Duel. Scores and progress sync through the host platform where supported.
features: Deterministic patterns instead of unfair random changes
controls: Tap anywhere; on desktop use Space or the left mouse button.
monetizationDisclosure: Contains ads. An optional rewarded video can double soft currency earned after a round.
